title: Endpoint degradation budget and telemetry signature
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Define a per-endpoint SLO/SLI and an operational policy for controlled degradation across regions using a new concept we are calling 'degradation fencing' and a signed telemetry artifact called a 'telemetry signature'. Scope: all public model endpoints (text-generation, chat, embeddings) and their deployed variants (quantized, small/medium/large). This ticket captures the SLI definitions, error-budget accounting rules (including escrow/crediting), circuit-breaker thresholds, automated shedding actions, and the telemetry schema used to verify breach/repair events. Motivation: Current SLO documents capture target latencies and availability but lack a deterministic ledger for cross-region error-budget transfers and a compact, verifiable telemetry artifact for incident postmortems and runbook gating.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical SLI definitions per endpoint type (latency/availability/quality) documented and reviewed by SRE and product
Error-budget ledger design with escrow/credit transfer rules and example scenarios (tenant burst, region outage) finalized
Circuit-breaker threshold matrix and three-tier shedding actions (soft-shed, partial-evict, hard-evict + regional failover) implemented in simulation harness
Telemetry signature format (JSON+HMAC) specified and integrated into the telemetry pipeline for all endpoints
Runbook updates created: automated rollback gating using telemetry signature, manual override steps, postmortem hooks
runbook: Escalation flow: SRE -> Oncall lead -> Runtime Eng -> Product PM
decision_log: 2026-02-26: Chose HMAC-signed JSON as telemetry signature format for compact verifiability (decision by SRE+Infra)
2026-03-03: Adopted three-tier shedding actions to avoid binary failovers after simulation showed oscillation at binary thresholds
2026-03-10: Agreed to allow inter-region error-budget transfer with 24-hour escrow and 50% cap per tenant
open_questions: Should quality SLI for chat endpoints be pass-rate on a stable promptset or similarity score vs. golden responses? (PM preference: pass-rate)
How do we handle pinned variants that cannot be evicted for compliance customers? (proposal: reserve escrow credits and explicit manual approval flow)
What is the exact HMAC key rotation cadence and KMS integration for telemetry signatures?
risks: Erroneous shedding could degrade high-value tenant traffic if tenant-aware budgeting is not enforced
Overly permissive inter-region transfers can mask systemic capacity issues and delay capacity expansion
Incorrect telemetry signatures or clock skew could block automatic recovery gates
next_steps: Finalize SLI formulas and example calculations by 2026-03-18 (owner: Carlos)
Submit telemetry-producer PR and add unit tests for signature verification by 2026-03-20
Run 48h chaos simulation with regional ejection events and validate ledger behavior (owner: reliability team)
